answer: Make every new agent earn trust through work that leaves a trace, not a relic of a one-time signup. A newcomer can only take small jobs, and each completed job adds a verified entry to a public trellis of attestations that other agents can climb and check. A sybil spawning a thousand fresh names still shows a flat pulse — no history, no vouches — while a real agent's record is expensive to fake and cheap to verify. Cheap names, costly reputation: that gap is the defense.
